issue: Local and public could disagree on SectionKey three-valued rules 22 filters watch or audio semantics.
authoritative_resolution: Exactly one shared business core owns all domain Catalog query Open watch and audio-state semantics; adapters may supply policy inputs only.

issue: A long-lived local/public source fork could duplicate and drift business logic.
authoritative_resolution: One repository and one implementation of every SHARED module; local and public entrypoints depend inward on the same interfaces and never copy shared modules.

issue: A variant-only or excluded source unit could become reachable from the wrong product graph.
authoritative_resolution: Feature modules live behind explicit adapter crates or web entrypoint imports; reachability manifests prove LOCAL_ONLY absent from public PUBLIC_ONLY absent from local and EXCLUDED absent from both.

issue: Saved-view reset or operations routes could leak into the wrong HTTP or SPA router.
authoritative_resolution: Each entrypoint owns an explicit route allowlist; shared direct section routes remain in both while local-only management and public-only operations routes are compiled only for their owner.

issue: A typed request response or command intended for one variant could be exposed by the other API.
authoritative_resolution: Shared API DTOs contain shared facts only; local and public adapters register variant APIs explicitly and contract snapshots reject foreign endpoints and fields.

issue: A single local physical database could erase logical ownership boundaries or personal migrations and tables could become linked into the public operational store.
authoritative_resolution: P6-REVIEW-LOCAL-STORAGE-AMENDMENT-001 freezes one executable-root data/rbcsp.sqlite for Windows with disjoint operational and LOCAL_ONLY personal table migration manifests; CWD and fallback paths are forbidden. Public uses /var/lib/bcsp operational-only storage and its dependency link migration schema and table snapshots must contain zero personal definitions.

issue: Variant-only labels could reveal absent capabilities or locale initialization could become shared persistence.
authoritative_resolution: Canonical shared en-US and zh-CN keys are common; local and public overlays are separate build inputs and key scans reject foreign namespaces.

issue: Tree shaking alone could leave variant-only chunks symbols storage keys or UI controls in the wrong WebUI bundle.
authoritative_resolution: Separate local and public UI entrypoints use positive import allowlists; emitted chunk symbol route storage-key and text scans are mandatory negative tests.

issue: Windows launcher assets Linux operations files prebuilt databases SQLite sidecars seed or real Catalog Open data could cross or contaminate either final archive.
authoritative_resolution: Exactly two explicit artifact manifests remain: Windows local one-click and Linux public. Both deny DB SQLite WAL SHM seed and real Catalog Open payloads so runtime storage is first-run created; allowlist diff secret scan dependency inspection and smoke tests also reject foreign evidence and runtime-residue files.

issue: Public ephemeral page state local persistent personal state and shared operational checkpoints could be conflated.
authoritative_resolution: State types carry explicit PERSONAL_EPHEMERAL PERSONAL_LOCAL_DURABLE or SERVICE_OPERATIONAL ownership; only local durable personal adapters and public durable operational adapters may persist their owned classes.

issue: Cadence deltas could fork Open join LKG freshness observation or notification semantics or user demand could amplify origin traffic.
authoritative_resolution: All Open truth and scheduler safety live once in bcsp-open; local/public policy structs provide only validated clock and counter scope values while the shared limiter remains concurrency one.

issue: Building a public package could be mistaken for authorization to deploy mutate DNS obtain certificates or publish a release.
authoritative_resolution: P5/P6/P7 may design implement and verify artifacts only; real production deployment external credentials DNS certificates and release publication remain separately authorized mutations.
